name: Saint Valentine
source:
This is the second game where we follow Mr. Grim, a man with an icy gaze, trained to kill.

In this episode, Mr. Grim is living in a hideout with a girl whose name is Emily.
On what appears to be a normal fugitive's day, Frank Grim receives a call from an old friend and suddenly the day becomes very hectic.

Frank will have to put his skills into play to complete a new mission involving a person from his past.

[From [url=https://black-hood-games.itch.io/saint-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是我们跟随格里姆先生的第二场比赛，他是一个眼神冰冷、受过杀人训练的人。

在这一集中，格里姆先生和一个名叫艾米丽的女孩住在一个藏身处。
在看似正常的逃亡者的一天，弗兰克·格里姆接到了一位老朋友的电话，突然这一天变得非常忙碌。

弗兰克必须发挥他的技能来完成一项涉及他过去的人的新任务。

[来自[url=https://black-hood-games.itch.io/saint-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
